| description = Fast (casts SOW on itself), casts root, fire spells and dispel. Drops eggs for the Prayer Shawl quests. <br>They can be found in the southeast quadrant between the bridge to Iceclad and Ry'Gorr fort. They tend to path just south of Iceclad Bridge.<br> Pathing nodes at: (-5992, -746), (-7108, -2073). Go to loc -7000, 1200 in Eastern Wastes. An Elder Snow Griffin and a Snow Griffin spawn close to it, and another pathes by it. Another location is -6150, -2295 where there is one spawn location of Elder Snow Griffin, an Elder that roams right onto that location, and a third Elder that roams South of that location and goes Westward. The Elders have a far greater chance of dropping an egg, up to 3:1 vs a regular Snow Griffin, it would appear (may need confirmation, seems about the same drop rate between the two). 

Best to pull them with a dispel as their damage shield will tear through your melee types.
